cases.d: Upload meeting documents from the computer.
steps: Open tab "Tài liệu" and add documents ("Tải từ máy").
Drop two PDFs and one DOCX in "Kéo tệp vào đây hoặc bấm để chọn" and confirm.
exp: The upload tray shows each file; then "Đã thêm tài liệu vào cuộc họp.".
The files are listed under Tài liệu chung and copied into the uploader's Kho tài liệu.
pre: A Published meeting; signed in as its Secretary; file storage configured.

cases.d: Upload limits and wrong file types are refused.
steps: Try to add a PNG renamed to .pdf.
Try to add 11 files at once.
Try a PDF larger than 50 MB.
exp: The wrong type is refused with "Hãy chọn tệp PDF hoặc DOCX hợp lệ, mỗi tệp không quá 50 MB." and nothing is added.
11 files: "Mỗi lần tải tối đa 10 tệp, tổng dung lượng không quá 200 MB.".
The large file is refused naming the 50 MB limit.
pre: Signed in as the meeting Secretary.

cases.d: Attach documents to an agenda item and remove them.
steps: Under an agenda item click "Thêm tài liệu cho mục này" and pick a meeting document.
Use "Gỡ khỏi cuộc họp" on a general document.
exp: "Đã gắn tài liệu vào mục nghị sự." then "Đã gỡ tài liệu khỏi mục nghị sự." appear.
A document removed from the meeting disappears from every list.
pre: A meeting with agenda items and documents; signed in as Chair or Secretary.

cases.d: Read a document and comment on a page.
steps: As thanhvien, open a PDF from tab Tài liệu.
Zoom in and out ("Phóng to", "Thu nhỏ").
Open Góp ý, tick "Gắn trang", write "Xem lại số liệu" and click "Gửi góp ý"; reply to it.
exp: The document opens full screen with "‹ Tài liệu" to go back.
"Đã gửi góp ý." appears; the comment shows the page number and the reply joins its thread.
In a Secret meeting the document can only be viewed ("Cuộc họp Mật: tài liệu chỉ xem trực tuyến, không tải về").
pre: A Published meeting with a PDF; thanhvien is invited.

cases.d: Add documents from my library to the meeting.
steps: In tab Tài liệu, add documents and choose "Từ kho của tôi".
Select two library documents and confirm.
exp: "Đã thêm tài liệu vào cuộc họp." appears.
The meeting uses the current names; renaming them later in the library does not rename them in the meeting.
pre: The Secretary has documents in Kho tài liệu.

cases.d: Documents of an ended or cancelled meeting stay readable but cannot be changed or commented.
steps: Open tab Tài liệu of an ended meeting and open a document.
exp: Documents open; add and remove actions are not offered.
The comment panel says "Cuộc họp đã kết thúc nên không góp ý thêm được." or "Cuộc họp đã huỷ nên không góp ý thêm được.".
pre: An ended and a cancelled meeting with documents.
